findings.description: A bar owner was arrested after an alleged baseball-bat attack in a dispute over a parking spot outside a bar at 1580 Haight St.

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “Haight bar owner arrested after alleged baseball bat attack over parking spot,” 27 September 2026

raw.text: …to jail at 1:17 a.m. Saturday, according to the San Francisco Sheriff’s Office. The incident began with a confrontation over parking on Friday outside Further…

publish.note: An arrest is a fact about a person, not the building. AGENTS.md is explicit that a crime or arrest at an address records what happened to the building, never a crime blotter naming or describing the people involved — and this story is entirely about the person arrested. Fails the ten-year test as a building fact.

resolution.method: Not resolved: the finding is declined, so no parcel is sought.

raw.text: the Sunset location at 3821 Noriega St. is doing even better than the duo hoped: It’s frequently packed with a mix of regulars and first-time visitors.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 3821 NORIEGA ST → parcel 2082001K; sf-parcels has blklot 2082001K active, 3821–3827 NORIEGA; the 2025 roll records it as commercial retail, built 1948.
